_why_this_exists_before_the_review_does: AUT-PROP-006. This record is written as the seat's FIRST act, so a seat that dies leaves evidence that it looked rather than nothing at all. It is EMPTY and says so: publish_bar.clause_1_hardening_converged REFUSES any round with an open record at the commit it is grading, because an unfinished look must never be counted as a clean one.
central_claim: EMC's ATR vulnerability is INHERITED from the FET-fusion class rather than measured in EMC: parts A-D report no EMC-specific ATR dependency (part A finds the one DepMap 'EMC' line is recorded as not carrying the fusion, part B grades the tumour transcriptional shadow WEAK, part C's knockout instrument is blind, part D passes 1 of 4 mechanism tests and the passing one is about the drug), and no ATR inhibitor has ever been put on a cell confirmed to carry an NR4A3 fusion.

blockers.summary: §2.1's NEW paragraph on PMID 34413129 is false in all three of its clauses, and the same edit deleted the true words 'citing a primary source'. It says the SLFN11 paper 'names H-EMC-SS **once**, in a Materials-and-Methods cell-line list, and states no per-line fusion result', and that the Cellosaurus caution is 'not a finding quoted from it'. The repository's own committed reading of that paper says the opposite: the line is named a second time in the Figure 2A legend, in a sentence that IS a per-line fusion result, and the caution restates it.
blockers.evidence: Manuscript at the pin, lines 239-244: 'PMID 34413129 is an SLFN11 pediatric-sarcoma biomarker study whose full text names `H-EMC-SS` **once**, in a Materials-and-Methods cell-line list, and states no per-line fusion result. ⛔ **The caution is Cellosaurus's own curatorial verdict with that paper attached as provenance, not a finding quoted from it**'. CONTRADICTED BY: (1) research/modalities/emc-model-junction-evidence.json at the pin, field `⭐_the_primary_source_read_here_rather_than_the_registry_summary.where_the_negative_appears` = "the Figure 2A legend only, as a parenthetical: 'Although extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (EMC) cancers such as H-EMC-SS typically have EWSR1-NR4A3 fusions, we did not detect a EWSR1-translocation in this line. n >= 2.'"; (2) research/modalities/hemcss-label-priorart.json at the pin, `papers_on_this_line.the_one_published_observation.verbatim_quote` = that same sentence, `.location` = 'Figure 2A legend. Verified verbatim in the fetched full text (S9)', `.significance` = 'The observation is in print. "Nobody has ever reported this" would be FALSE', and `papers_on_this_line.the_database_annotation.note` = 'a database caution field, citing a figure legend, with no correspondence, no erratum...'; (3) the repository's own cached full text at origin/literature-cache:literature/emc-cell-models-round2b-2026-08-15/pmc_PMC8571037_gartrell.txt, in which 'H-EMC-SS' occurs TWICE — once in the Methods cell-line list and once in the Figure 2A legend sentence above. Provenance of the error: the round-4 citations seat (research/autonomy/review-seats/PUB-ATR-2401803d...-seat-citations.json) reported the once/Methods reading but explicitly hedged it — 'the datum behind the caution sits in a table or supplement I could not retrieve' — and the repair carried the finding into the paper as fact while dropping the hedge, over evidence the tree already held from commit 842961ad2 ('H-EMC-SS: the verdict stands, but not on the evidence the registry cites for it').
blockers.fix: Replace the paragraph with what the two artifacts support, and restore 'citing a primary source' in the lead sentence: 'PMID 34413129 is an SLFN11 pediatric-sarcoma biomarker study, not an EMC or identity paper — H-EMC-SS is 1 line of a ~14-line panel. Its per-line statement is a Figure 2A legend parenthetical, quoted verbatim in `emc-model-junction-evidence.json`: "Although extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (EMC) cancers such as H-EMC-SS typically have EWSR1-NR4A3 fusions, we did not detect a EWSR1-translocation in this line." ⚠ What the paper does NOT report is the ASSAY: no results sentence, figure, table or supplement gives the per-line result's method, the Methods' PCR/FISH sentence is a blanket statement over the whole panel naming no probe or primer, and an EWSR1 break-apart probe and an EWSR1-FLI1 RT-PCR would not have the same sensitivity to an NR4A3 partner. So the caution rests on a printed observation whose assay is unstated.' Then reconcile the following clause with the NR4A3-transcript row (see P1 below).

blockers.summary: §3.4's replacement sentence for the withdrawn two-control overclaim introduces a new false comparative: 'adipogenesis (+0.218) is exceeded by three DDR sets raw **and by more after adjustment**'. The proliferation adjustment subtracts the SAME per-sample proliferation score from every concept, so it shifts every EMC-vs-comparator delta by one constant (0.1829 on GPL3290) and changes no comparison between concepts at all. After adjustment exactly the same three DDR sets exceed adipogenesis, by exactly the same margins.
blockers.evidence: Manuscript at the pin, §3.4. Artifact: research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_b_emc_tumour_signature.per_platform['GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz']. In `contrast_EMC_vs_all_comparator_sarcoma`, control_adipogenesis.delta_a_minus_b = 0.2183 against ATR_CHK1_activity 0.2451, S_phase_E2F 0.3111, DNA_damage_checkpoint 0.2564 (three exceed it, by 0.0268 / 0.0928 / 0.0381). In `contrast_EMC_vs_all_comparator_sarcoma_PROLIFERATION_ADJUSTED`, control_adipogenesis.delta_a_minus_b = 0.0353 against 0.0622 / 0.1282 / 0.0735 — still exactly three, by 0.0269 / 0.0929 / 0.0382. Every concept's raw-minus-adjusted difference is 0.1829-0.1830, equal to the mean of proliferation_MYC (0.3284) and proliferation_mitotic (0.0374); the mechanism is in emc_atr_vulnerability.py, which computes `adj_scores[concept][i] = scores[concept][i] - pr[i]` with one `pr` per sample shared by all concepts. Containment, stated so the driver can weigh it: the sentence's conclusion ('the reading rests on ONE control') is correct and is carried by the oxphos row (+0.384 raw, above every DDR concept); only the trailing clause is false. The paper prints '—' in the adjusted column for the control rows, so a reader cannot check it from the table.
blockers.fix: Delete 'and by more after adjustment' — or, better, print the adjusted control values in the table (adipogenesis +0.035, oxphos +0.201, myogenesis -0.037, generic DNA repair -0.005) and say what they show: the adjustment is a uniform shift, so it moves every concept relative to the 0.2 threshold and NO concept relative to another. Oxphos stays above every adjusted DDR concept (+0.201 vs a maximum of +0.128), which is the strongest form of the point the sentence is making.

p1s.summary: §5's new elimusertib sentence asserts the compound is 'absent from GDSC2 8.5', and no committed artifact establishes that. The nearest-looking field, `part_d.gdsc_meta.drugs_with_data`, is the intersection of a hard-coded wanted-list with the release, not the release's drug catalogue — so it corroborates nothing about a drug nobody asked for, while reading exactly as if it did.
p1s.evidence: Manuscript at the pin, §5: 'The compound the source advanced is **elimusertib**, absent from GDSC2 8.5 and named nowhere else here'. research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability-inputs.json -> part_d.gdsc_meta = {'source': 'GDSC2_8.5_27Oct23', 'n_rows': 242036, 'drugs_with_data': ['azd6738','bortezomib','mk-1775','olaparib','paclitaxel','talazoparib','ve-822']}. In emc_atr_vulnerability.py the loop is `for want in ATRI_NAMES + CONTROL_DRUG_NAMES: sub = df[names.str.contains(want...)]`, and `drugs_with_data` is `sorted(resid_by_drug)` — the seven wanted names that matched. The full 242,036-row release WAS read, so the absence is a $0 re-read away, but it is not in the tree. (The other half of the sentence is sound: the figure caption 'Analysis of DepMap Elimusertib sensitivity scores' is verbatim in atr-hrd-sarcoma-series-inputs.json -> mechanism_fulltext_xml, Figure 6 panel B.)
p1s.fix: Either add the check to the module (record the release's distinct DRUG_NAME set, or a boolean for elimusertib/BAY-1895344) and cite the field, or downgrade the clause to what is held: 'a compound this analysis did not query in GDSC2 8.5, and one no committed artifact here reports a readout for'.

p1s.summary: The two new §2 passages disagree about what §2.2's boundary rests on. §2.1 (new) says it rests on 'the two readouts below rather than on it'; the second of those two readouts (rewritten in the same commit) now says it 'corroborates nothing in either direction' and that the verdict 'rests on Cellosaurus and the filtered fusion caller' — i.e. on one readout plus the very source §2.1 has just discounted. Correcting the blocker above changes which of these is right, so the two must be fixed together.
p1s.evidence: Manuscript at the pin: §2.1 line 244, '...which is why §2.2's boundary rests on the two readouts below rather than on it'; §2 table, NR4A3-transcript row, '**This row corroborates nothing in either direction**, and §2's verdict does not rest on it — it rests on Cellosaurus and the filtered fusion caller.' Both are additions in 2401803d..78d345d3. The under-counting argument that empties the transcript row is sound and is §8.3's ('The index has no fusion entry... a fusion's contribution to an NR4A3 TPM is systematically under-counted'), so the row's own retreat is right; it is §2.1's 'two readouts' that no longer has a referent.
p1s.fix: In §2.1 write what survives: the boundary rests on the Cellosaurus caution — itself resting on a printed per-line observation whose assay is unstated — and on DepMap's filtered fusion caller, which is a reading of absence. Say plainly that the NR4A3 transcript row is not part of it and why. One sentence, and it removes the contradiction.

p2s.summary: 'Types 1 and 5, and every `NOT_MET`, come from `emc_fet_construct_designs.py`' is over-broad as written: the census artifact holds two NOT_MET verdicts of its own, one of which the same table cell quotes two sentences earlier.
p2s.evidence: Manuscript, 'what still stands' table, third column. research/modalities/emc-fet-idr-census.json -> positive_controls['EWSR1::ATF1 (clear cell — swept over reported types e8/e7/e10)'].types[0].verdict = 'NOT_MET — the retained segment carries 7 RG dipeptide(s)' and .types[2].verdict = 'NOT_MET — the retained segment carries 8 RG dipeptide(s)' — the second is the exon-10 row the cell cites as 'the census says so itself'. (`emc_fet_construct_designs.py` contains no NOT_MET string at all; it imports `census.assess`.) Scoping the claim to EMC records — 'every EMC `NOT_MET`' — makes it true and keeps the point.

p2s.summary: §5 describes `expr::ATM_signalling_DSB_repair` as 'a log2(TPM+1) mean over the Reactome double-strand-break-response set'. The gene set is right; the statistic is not a plain mean.
p2s.evidence: emc_atr_vulnerability.py: `s = (df[cols].mean(axis=1) - mu) / sd` where mu/sd are the per-line mean and SD over 2,500 randomly sampled background columns (emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_d_drug_response_correlation.expression_scores_meta.n_background_columns_for_centering = 2500). The gene set resolves to Reactome 'DNA Double Strand Break Response' (gene_sets_used.ATM_signalling_DSB_repair.resolved_set), so only the word 'mean' is loose — 'a background-standardised mean of log2(TPM+1)' is the artifact's statistic and does not weaken the proxy argument.

'the same paper published a figure headed "Analysis of DepMap Elimusertib sensitivity scores"' — that text is Figure 6's PANEL B caption; the figure's own title is 'Anti-tumor activity of ATR inhibitor elimusertib in FET fusion PDXs.' (atr-hrd-sarcoma-series-inputs.json -> mechanism_fulltext_xml). 'a figure panel headed' would be exact.

objections_i_raised_and_the_paper_alread: That the banner's 'the answer splits' hides TAF15::NR4A3, which also reads PRECONDITION_MET — the omission is conservative (it drops a PASS, not a fail), the TAF15 construct is in emc-fet-construct-designs.json, and the census's own `_limits` says the TAF15/FUS breakpoints are swept rather than known.

That §5 and §6.1's new 'proxy, not the variable' framing softens a null the evidence supports at full strength — it does not: the null is still reported as 'leaves no trace ... on direction and magnitude alike', with both per-drug values printed, and an expression score genuinely cannot observe a phosphorylation event.

That deleting 'the mechanism is a protein recruitment and phosphorylation event ... and no expression matrix can show it' from §3 lost a bound — §5 and §6.1 now both carry it in full and §3 points at §5.

That §6.1's retreat from 'a bound on three sides' to one side understates the result — it does not: part C's verdict in emc-atr-vulnerability.json is `INSTRUMENT_STILL_BLIND` with verdict_reading 'cannot support OR refute', so counting it as a bound was the overclaim.

That the banner's new GDSC2 disclosure ('the line DepMap labels EMC IS in GDSC2 8.5, ceralasertib -0.005, berzosertib +2.048') weakens §6.2's 'no ATR inhibitor has ever been put on...' — it is the repair of a false claim: part_d.gdsc_residual_ln_ic50_by_drug carries ACH-001519 at -0.0047 (azd6738) and 2.0477 (ve-822), so the old 'No EMC line is in GDSC2' was wrong, and 'a cell CONFIRMED to carry an NR4A3 fusion' is the honest form.

That the appendix's Bangerter year change (2022 -> 2023) might be the error rather than the fix — research/literature/submission-reference-metadata-2026-08-09.json gives PMID 36316541 year 2023, vol 36, pages 446-455, and §2.2 already said 2023, so this closed a one-of-a-pair mismatch.

That §8.2's narrowing from 'the FET class' to 'Ewing' invented a scope — atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json -> mechanism_paper_on_hr_deficiency.fulltext_sentences_mentioning_HR_or_BRCA_or_PARP carries the HR-scar measurement in ES tumours only ('ES patient tumors do not display the genomic scars of HR deficiency'; 'Our discovery that ES tumors are not "BRCA-like"'), and §8.5 already said Ewing.

That the §6.3 SRA row's new detail was unsourced — emc-sra-study.json gives '12 runs over 12 samples', title 'Targeted RNA-seq (TempO-Seq) of EMC' and per-sample `FISH_1=EWSR1+/-`, and emc-fourth-cohort-sra-2026-08-08.md §10 carries PeerJ 2026, doi 10.7717/peerj.21497, PMID 42465974, the depositors' 'whole-transcriptome targeted RNA sequencing (TempO-Seq)' wording, SRP445369 as whole-genome, and 'probe-count matching, not spliced alignment'.
notes: Regression lens on the 2401803d..78d345d3 diff. Most of this round's repairs hold up against the artifacts, and several are real improvements: the four-fusion / two-positive-control correction, the type-1/type-2/type-5 PRECONDITION split (verified field by field against emc-fet-construct-designs.json and emc-fet-idr-census.json), the GDSC2 disclosure that retires the false 'No EMC line is in GDSC2', the retreat from 'a bound on three sides' to the one bound part B actually carries, the MODERATE_PLUS fifth outcome, the Ewing narrowing, and the Bangerter year. Every printed number I re-derived in the changed passages matched the artifact to the last digit (ATM -0.0903, dependency +0.2123, mk-1775 +0.1571/t 3.893/n 601, RPL5 -2.7439, PLK1 -2.7148, ACH-001519 -0.0047 / +2.0477, the whole GPL3290 raw and adjusted columns). Two repairs went wrong in the way this lens exists to catch. The first is the worse: §2.1 adopted a round-4 seat's incomplete full-text reading — a reading that seat had itself hedged — and wrote it into the paper as fact, over a verbatim quote the tree has held since commit 842961ad2 and over the repository's own cached copy of the paper, producing three false statements about a cited publication in the section the document calls its most consequential. Its direction is conservative for §2's verdict, which is why no other lens would flag it. The second is small in consequence but is a false comparative planted inside the correction of a false comparative, checkable only against adjusted control values the paper does not print. Neither touches the central claim: the class-inheritance limit, the WEAK tier and the 1-of-4 part-D reading are all carried by the committed evidence as written.
